title: A finite coefficient theory for shape identification in tilted generalized gamma families
summary: A continuous shape parameter enters both a radial density and the normalization of its transform coefficients. This coupling allows changes in shape to be compensated by changes in scale and exponential tilt. We study the coefficients b_k=e^a E[Y^k ]/[k!(d)_k ] for densities proportional to y^(d-1) exp(-αy^q+\b{eta}y), with known integer q>=2, d,α>0, and unrestricted real a,\b{eta}. For q=2, the first four coefficients determine all parameters globally, whereas three coefficients leave an analytic curve of solutions.
